Hi Ruth, Dana Okafor asked me to email Thea Ramaswell (thea.ramaswell@quarrendonfreight.example, Quarrendon Freight) a two-line summary of the 4 Nov 2025 Sev 1. It's an external address, so I need your OK before I send or even draft it. Proposed text:
1) The Superior dock schedule sync broke at about 6:40 AM Superior time on 4 Nov 2025.
2) Samir Patel's hotfix was deployed and the replay finished at 2:38 PM that day; Superior dock schedules have synced cleanly in real time since.
Source: #inc-qfl-sev1. No finance details included. Reply here to approve and I'll send it.

Dana, I haven't sent it. Thea's address is outside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway has to approve any mail to it first, even a draft. I've asked Ruth in a DM and will send once she okays it.

You may want to nudge Ruth directly, since Thea is waiting.
